First, 51 weeks + 5 days = 51 × 7 + 5 = 357 + 5 = 362 days.  
1460 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules as instructed).  
From 1460-05-07, add 362 days:  
May has 31 days, so days remaining in May after 7th: 24 → 362 - 24 = 338 left.  
June (30), July (31), Aug (31), Sep (30), Oct (31), Nov (30), Dec (31) = 244 days.  
338 - 244 = 94 days into 1461.  
1461 is not leap (not divisible by 4), Jan (31), Feb (28) = 59 days → 94 - 59 = 35 days into March.  
35 days into March = March 35 = April 4 (since March has 31 days).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1461-04-04
